title: effusiella ximenae
intro: Effusiella ximenae, commonly known as "golden shield fern," is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Taiwan, for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Effusiella ximenae include wound healing, antiseptic, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
